fusions.name: Thrown Seam
fusions.desc: A thrown spear that deals 30 damage, up to 2 times that at maximum range, and also deals 5% of a boss's or elite's maximum health.

fusions.name: Pinning Throw
fusions.desc: Hurls a spear that deals 12 damage, stuns the target for 1.2 seconds and leaves it [Pinned] for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Thrown Step
fusions.desc: A short burst of movement that carries you 4 tiles forward. Your movement speed rises by 20% for 4 seconds after you use it.

fusions.name: Skewer Line
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, a spear flies to the nearest enemy within 8 tiles, dealing 8 damage. Once every 6 seconds.
